
## 4. 核心模块设计

### 4.1 游戏主入口 (Game.js)

```javascript
// src/core/Game.js
class Game {
    constructor(canvasId) {
        this.canvas = document.getElementById(canvasId);
        this.ctx = this.canvas.getContext('2d');
        
        // 核心组件
        this.renderer = new Renderer(this.ctx);
        this.inputHandler = new InputHandler(this.canvas);
        this.audioManager = new AudioManager();
        this.stateMachine = new StateMachine();
        
        // 游戏配置
        this.config = {
            fps: 60,
            width: 800,
            height: 600
        };
        
        this.init();
    }
    
    init() {
        // 初始化状态机
        this.stateMachine.register('MENU', new MenuState(this));
        this.stateMachine.register('PLAYING', new PlayingState(this));
        this.stateMachine.register('GAMEOVER', new GameOverState(this));
        
        // 绑定输入
        this.inputHandler.on('start', () => this.stateMachine.change('PLAYING'));
        
        // 启动渲染循环
        this.lastTime = 0;
        this.gameLoop = this.gameLoop.bind(this);
        requestAnimationFrame(this.gameLoop);
    }
    
    gameLoop(timestamp) {
        const deltaTime = timestamp - this.lastTime;
        this.lastTime = timestamp;
        
        // 更新当前状态
        this.stateMachine.update(deltaTime);
        // 渲染当前状态
        this.stateMachine.render(this.renderer);
        
        requestAnimationFrame(this.gameLoop);
    }
}
```

### 4.2 状态机 (StateMachine.js)

```javascript
// src/logic/StateMachine.js
class StateMachine {
    constructor() {
        this.states = new Map();
        this.currentState = null;
    }
    
    register(name, state) {
        this.states.set(name, state);
    }
    
    change(stateName, params = {}) {
        if (this.currentState && this.currentState.exit) {
            this.currentState.exit();
        }
        
        this.currentState = this.states.get(stateName);
        
        if (this.currentState && this.currentState.enter) {
            this.currentState.enter(params);
        }
    }
    
    update(deltaTime) {
        if (this.currentState && this.currentState.update) {
            this.currentState.update(deltaTime);
        }
    }
    
    render(renderer) {
        if (this.currentState && this.currentState.render) {
            this.currentState.render(renderer);
        }
    }
}
```

### 4.3 开始按钮组件 (StartButton.js)

```javascript
// src/ui/StartButton.js
class StartButton {
    constructor(x, y, width, height, text, onClick) {
        this.x = x;
        this.y = y;
        this.width = width;
        this.height = height;
        this.text = text;
        this.onClick = onClick;
        
        this.isHovered = false;
        this.isClicked = false;
        
        this.colors = {
            normal: '#4CAF50',
            hover: '#45a049',
            active: '#3d8b40',
            text: '#ffffff'
        };
    }
    
    // 绑定到画布的点击事件
    bindEvents(inputHandler) {
        inputHandler.on('click', (pos) => {
            if (this.isPointInside(pos.x, pos.y)) {
                this.onClick && this.onClick();
            }
        });
        
        inputHandler.on('mousemove', (pos) => {
            this.isHovered = this.isPointInside(pos.x, pos.y);
        });
    }
    
    isPointInside(x, y) {
        return x >= this.x && x <= this.x + this.width &&
               y >= this.y && y <= this.y + this.height;
    }
    
    render(renderer) {
        const color = this.isClicked ? this.colors.active : 
                      this.isHovered ? this.colors.hover : 
                      this.colors.normal;
        
        // 绘制按钮背景
        renderer.drawRect(this.x, this.y, this.width, this.height, color, 8);
        
        // 绘制按钮文字
        renderer.drawText(
            this.text,
            this.x + this.width / 2,
            this.y + this.height / 2,
            '24px Arial',
            this.colors.text,
            'center',
            'middle'
        );
    }
}
```

### 4.4 渲染器 (Renderer.js)

```javascript
// src/core/Renderer.js
class Renderer {
    constructor(ctx) {
        this.ctx = ctx;
    }
    
    clear(width, height) {
        this.ctx.fillStyle = '#1a1a2e';
        this.ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
    }
    
    drawRect(x, y, width, height, color, radius = 0) {
        this.ctx.fillStyle = color;
        
        if (radius > 0) {
            this.ctx.beginPath();
            this.ctx.roundRect(x, y, width, height, radius);
            this.ctx.fill();
        } else {
            this.ctx.fillRect(x, y, width, height);
        }
    }
    
    drawCircle(x, y, radius, color) {
        this.ctx.fillStyle = color;
        this.ctx.beginPath();
        this.ctx.arc(x, y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        this.ctx.fill();
    }
    
    drawText(text, x, y, font, color, align = 'left', baseline = 'top') {
        this.ctx.font = font;
        this.ctx.fillStyle = color;
        this.ctx.textAlign = align;
        this.ctx.textBaseline = baseline;
        this.ctx.fillText(text, x, y);
    }
    
    drawImage(image, x, y, width, height) {
        if (image.complete) {
            this.ctx.drawImage(image, x, y, width, height);
        }
    }
}
```

### 5.1 游戏状态流转

```
┌─────────┐  点击开始   ┌──────────┐  游戏结束   ┌──────────┐
│  MENU   │──────────▶│ PLAYING  │──────────▶│ GAMEOVER │
└─────────┘            └──────────┘            └──────────┘
     ▲                                              │
     │            重新开始                            │
     └──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### 5.2 各状态职责

| 状态 | 进入条件 | 核心行为 | 退出条件 |
|------|----------|----------|----------|
| MENU | 程序启动 | 显示开始按钮，等待点击 | 点击开始按钮 |
| PLAYING | 点击开始 | 执行游戏逻辑，渲染画面 | 触发游戏结束条件 |
| GAMAMEOVER | 游戏结束 | 显示最终分数，重新开始按钮 | 点击重新开始 |

dx * i, y - dy * i if 0 <= nx < 15 and 0 <= ny < 15 and board[ny][nx] == player: count += 1 else: break if count >= 5: return True return False def save_record(winner, moves): """保存游戏记录""" conn = sqlite3.connect('data/gomoku.db') c = conn.cursor() winner_name = '黑棋' if winner == 1 else '白棋' c.execute('INSERT INTO game_records (winner, moves) VALUES (?, ?)', (winner_name, moves)) conn.commit() conn.close() @app.route('/api/records') def get_records(): """获取游戏记录""" conn = sqlite3.connect('data/gomoku.db') conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row c = conn.cursor() c.execute('SELECT * FROM game_records ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10') records = [dict(row) for row in c.fetchall()] conn.close() return jsonify(records) if __name__ == '__main__': socketio.run(app, host='0.0.0.0', port=5000, debug=True) ``` ### 3.2 前端 -
